case_title: ELIZABETH O'NEILL ET AL VS. JULIA APARTMENTS, LP

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,000.00 FILED BY O'NEILL, ELIZABETH TANCIO, TRISTAN AS TO DEFENDANT JULIA APARTMENTS, LP ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-01-2023 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$112.00); <SARA FLYNN, MANAGER - LISTED AGENT> SERVED JUN-14-2023, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT JULIA APARTMENTS, LP
STIPULATION TO ALLOW THE MATTER TO BE HEARD BEFORE A JPT FILED BY O'NEILL, ELIZABETH TANCIO, TRISTAN JULIA APARTMENTS, LP
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) MARC RYNING, AGENT FOR LANDLORD FILED BY DEFENDANT JULIA APARTMENTS, LP
ORDER TO DISMISS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-01-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO SEP-08-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFFS ELIZABETH O'NEIL & TRISTIAN TANIO ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT JULIA APARTMENTS, LP IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY MARC RYNING, AGENT FOR LANDLORD. PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WHEREBY DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF $1662.00 TO FULLY RESOLVE THE CASE. PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR SEP-08-2023 AT 15:30 PM, IF NO APPEARANCES THEN DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE. IF THERE IS AN APPEARANCE WHERE PLAINTIFFS HAVE NOT RECEIVED FULL PAYMENT, THEN A DECISION IN FAVOR OF PLAINTIFF 1) $1500, PRINCIPAL 2) $0 INTEREST 3) $162 COSTS. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ALLYSYN OVERTON; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
